probe: can a claude plugin eval case select a plugin output style (needed under B9)
method: Scratch copy of dist/claude-code/agent-reply with one case whose prompt.md frontmatter carried a candidate key; claude plugin eval ./plug --case c --runs 1 --ablation none --max-cost-usd 0.001. Validator messages only; no model run.

results.result: accepted by the loader; run failed: only EVAL_* keys can be set from case.yaml

finding: A case cannot select an output style: there is no settings key, env is limited to EVAL_* keys, and runs use a temporary home. Plugin settings.json supports only agent and subagentStatusLine (06 §2.1). Under B9 (unforced styles) the tool's plugin-on arm therefore runs with no style selected, which is arm B, not arm C. Policy cases cannot stay in claude plugin eval.
cleanup: The tool kept a sealed temp directory for the failed run; it was unsealed and removed.
